summary: Sapa is the base for the terraces below town. Mai Chau is the closer valley. Tam Coc is rice and karst from a boat.
body: Sapa sits above the Muong Hoa valley. The terraces and the Hmong and Giay villages are below town, in Cat Cat, Lao Chai, and Ta Van. Treat the walks as visits to people’s fields. Go for two nights at least. Mist is part of the place.

Mai Chau is a wide rice valley with Thai stilt houses, closer and gentler than Sapa, and a fair one-night escape from Hanoi. Tam Coc is the boat along the Ngo Dong through low caves, with rice and karst on both sides. Ninh Binh is that same country. Mua Cave is the stair to the view. Ha Giang’s guide is the loop, the markets, and buckwheat in autumn.
